# release-strip.txt
#
# Canonical list of develop-only paths that are removed from the repository
# before a release is merged into master.
#
# Used by: tools/prepare-release.sh
# Format:  one path per line, relative to the repo root.
#          Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
#          Both files and directories are supported.
#          Trailing slashes on directories are optional — the script
#          handles both forms.
#
# Updating this list:
#   - Add a path here whenever you add a new develop-only artefact.
#   - Keep entries sorted alphabetically within each section.
#   - Do NOT list files that should remain on master (src/, tests/,
#     CMakeLists.txt, LICENSE, README.md, resources.qrc, etc.).

# ── Internal design & specification documents ──────────────────────────────
docs/
spec/

# ── Developer tooling ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tools/

# ── Release automation support files (used by tools/ only) ─────────────────
.github/release-strip.txt

# ── Claude Code configuration (AI assistant context, not end-user facing) ──
# .claude/ is git-ignored on develop, but listed here as a safety net in case
# it ever gets tracked accidentally.
.claude/

# ── Local git hooks (developers configure these on clone; not needed on master) ──
.githooks/

# ── Developer-facing guidance files ────────────────────────────────────────
CLAUDE.md
AGENTS.md

# ── Clang static-analysis config (dev build tooling only) ──────────────────
.clangd

# ── YAML lint config (dev tooling, not needed on master) ───────────────────
.yamllint

# ── Temporary / scratch assets used during prototyping ─────────────────────
book_reader_icon.jpg
